article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-leaning hybrid
Genetics: Spritzer × Grape Gas
Breeder: Compound Genetics
THC Content: 27–30%
CBD Content: Typically low
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , linalool , beta-caryophyllene
Primary Flavors: Plum, dark berries, sweet fruit, grape candy
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: late September through October
Indoor Yield: Medium to high
Outdoor Yield: Medium to high
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Nearly black flowers covered in silver resin give Mellowz the appearance of cannabis that was bred for photographs, but its reputation was built just as much on what happens after the jar is opened. Plum, dark berries, sweet fruit, and candy overlap in the aroma, creating a dense purple-fruit character that carries surprisingly well into the flavor. Compound Genetics developed the strain from Spritzer × Grape Gas, and the pairing produced enough exceptional offspring that the breeder described the original hunt as having an unusually high number of keeper-quality plants. Rather than one standout surrounded by average siblings, multiple selections displayed different combinations of appearance, flavor, resin, and production.

That success eventually made Mellowz more than a single cultivar in Compound Genetics’ catalog. Its combination of exotic flower quality and strong resin characteristics became important enough to serve as the foundation for a later Mellowz breeding collection. The original plant remains the reference point, however: compact dark-purple buds, medium-sized calyxes, dense glittering trichomes, fast vegetative growth, an 8–9-week flowering period, and cannabinoid tests frequently reaching 27–30% THC or higher. For consumers, the attraction is a rich fruit-and-candy profile wrapped around potent, gradually relaxing effects; for growers, it is the unusual ability to combine premium bag appeal with genuinely useful production traits.
Genetics and Lineage

Mellowz is the direct offspring of Spritzer and Grape Gas. The Spritzer parent was bred by Cannarado Genetics and became valuable to Compound Genetics after early evaluation revealed an elite clone with very large yield potential, delicate but exceptionally appealing terpenes, and the unusual ability to carry its aroma clearly into the finished taste. Spritzer itself belongs to a modern dessert-and-fruit genetic family involving Runtz , Grape Pie , and MAC ancestry, helping explain why its descendants can combine candy sweetness, fruit, resin, color, and vigorous production without depending entirely on heavy fuel.

Grape Gas, also known as Grape Gasoline, is Compound Genetics’ cross of Grape Pie × Jet Fuel Gelato . Grape Pie descends from Grape Stomper × Cherry Pie and contributes dark fruit, purple coloration, sweetness, and a terpene background frequently associated with limonene, myrcene, and linalool. Jet Fuel Gelato combines Gelato 45 with High Octane × Jet Fuel G6, adding beta-caryophyllene-rich spice, gas, creamy Gelato depth, and the petroleum intensity that gives Grape Gas its name. Compound describes the parent’s aroma memorably as sweet grape candy backed by aggressive gasoline.

Crossing Spritzer with Grape Gas concentrated fruit and confectionary traits while preserving enough structure and resin to make the offspring commercially useful. The most recognizable Mellowz expressions move away from sharp gasoline and toward plum, berries, dark fruit, and sweet candy, although the Grape Gas influence remains apparent in their saturated purple-fruit character. The genetic combination also proved unusually productive as breeding material, which is why Compound later returned to Mellowz as a parent for additional crosses rather than treating the cultivar as a one-time release.
Effects and Experience

Mellowz tends to enter through the head before settling more deeply into the body. The early stage can feel euphoric, mentally lighter, and pleasantly detached from routine stress without necessarily producing frantic stimulation. Music, movies , conversation, games, or other low-pressure activities may become more absorbing, while the overall mood takes on an easygoing quality that fits the strain’s name. The cerebral effect can remain clear enough at moderate doses to enjoy an activity rather than immediately abandoning it for the couch.

Physical relaxation becomes more evident as the initial lift develops. Limbs may begin to feel heavier, the body settles, and the pace of thought gradually slows without an abrupt switch into sedation. Stronger servings can push the cultivar considerably further, producing a hazier and more enveloping experience suited to an evening with few obligations. Appetite can also become more noticeable as the high matures, particularly in consumers already prone to THC-related hunger.

Potency is an important part of the experience. Compound Genetics reports flower from the cultivar consistently testing around 27–30% THC or higher, placing well-grown Mellowz firmly in the high-potency category. That strength can make a small amount sufficient for experienced consumers and potentially overwhelming for someone with limited tolerance. Excess consumption may bring dry mouth, dry eyes, dizziness, impaired short-term memory, or temporary anxiety, so the strain generally rewards measured dosing despite its soft fruit-candy flavor.
Medical Benefits

The gradual movement from euphoria into physical calm may appeal to medical cannabis consumers seeking a cultivar that changes character over the course of the session. During the brighter early period, stress, low mood, or mental fatigue may feel less intrusive, while the later body component can make muscular tension and everyday physical discomfort easier to set aside. That combination often fits late-afternoon or evening use more naturally than mornings requiring sustained concentration and coordination.

At higher doses, the experience can become substantially more relaxing and may encourage appetite, stillness, and eventual drowsiness. Those characteristics can make the strain attractive to patients who prefer marijuana with a stronger nighttime direction, although high THC does not affect everyone the same way. Consumers vulnerable to cannabis-induced anxiety may find that a large serving produces overstimulation before the calming phase develops, making gradual dose adjustment especially important.

Mellowz has a better-defined terpene profile than many seed lines. Compound Genetics identifies myrcene, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene as dominant terpenes in the cultivar, matching its combination of ripe fruit, floral softness, spice, and deeper aromatic weight. Terpenes contribute to aroma and sensory character, but they should not be treated as stand-alone medical treatments. Batch-specific cannabinoid testing, medications, individual tolerance, and prior response to high-THC cannabis remain more useful when deciding whether a particular harvest is appropriate for therapeutic use.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Dark fruit is where Mellowz separates itself from brighter tropical or citrus cultivars . Plum sits prominently at the center, followed by mixed berries and a sweet fruit quality that can resemble concentrated jam rather than freshly cut produce. The aroma has depth without needing a dominant sour or skunky component, and the exceptionally dark flowers reinforce the sensory impression before the buds are even broken apart.

Candy appears behind the fruit and becomes particularly noticeable in the finished flavor. Grape Gas contributes some of that confectionary character, creating a sweetness that can recall grape candy without reducing the entire profile to artificial grape. Spritzer adds additional delicacy and helps the aroma translate exceptionally well into smoke or vapor. Some plants may show traces of floral softness or spice, consistent with linalool and beta-caryophyllene, but these details generally remain underneath the plum-and-berry core.

On the palate, ripe fruit arrives first, while berry sweetness and candy persist into the finish. Vaporization can preserve the lighter fruit and floral elements particularly well, whereas combustion tends to emphasize the darker, denser side of the terpene profile. A slow dry and controlled cure are critical for preserving the distinctive plum notes; rushing post-harvest processing can flatten the profile into generalized sweetness and hide much of the complexity that makes properly finished Mellowz memorable.
Growing Information

Fast vegetative growth gives Mellowz an immediate advantage for cultivators trying to build a productive canopy without an unnecessarily long veg cycle. The Spritzer parent was selected partly for exceptional yield, and the cross can carry that productive character into plants that still finish with boutique-quality flower. Topping, low-stress training, or a trellis can be used to spread vigorous branches into an even canopy, while selective pruning underneath helps direct energy toward well-lit flower sites. Growers should plan for the final density of the buds rather than allowing foliage and branches to crowd one another early.

Flowering takes approximately 8–9 weeks. As maturity approaches, the strain can become visually dramatic, producing compact buds with medium-sized calyxes and pigmentation ranging from deep purple to nearly black. Dense glittering trichomes cover the flower heavily, and breeder-selected material is suitable for both premium flower and hash production. Because the buds become compact and resinous, late-flower airflow and humidity management deserve careful attention. Stable irrigation and balanced nutrition are more valuable than excessive feeding when the goal is preserving the terpene intensity and clean burn expected from high-end marijuana.

Outdoor plants need enough favorable autumn weather to complete the same 8–9-week flowering window, generally putting harvest somewhere from late September into October in many Northern Hemisphere gardens. The exact date depends on latitude, climate, and when natural flowering begins. Full sunlight and adequate root volume can make use of the cultivar’s vigorous vegetative pace, while the dark, resinous flowers should be protected from prolonged rain near maturity. Growers hunting multiple plants may want to evaluate plum intensity, berry sweetness, color, resin quality, flower density, and hash performance together, since the breeder’s original hunt demonstrated that several different expressions can be worthy of preservation.
FAQ
What strains make Mellowz?
Mellowz was bred by Compound Genetics from Spritzer × Grape Gas. Spritzer was developed by Cannarado Genetics, while Compound’s Grape Gas is a cross of Grape Pie × Jet Fuel Gelato.
Is Mellowz indica or sativa?

Mellowz is a hybrid that commonly displays indica-leaning effects. The high may begin with noticeable cerebral euphoria and mental uplift before progressing toward stronger physical relaxation and a calmer, heavier finish.
What does Mellowz taste like?

The breeder describes the cultivar around plum, dark fruit, berries, sweet fruit, and candy. Grape Gas contributes a recognizable confectionary fruit character, while Spritzer helps give the flavor a softer and more nuanced finish.
How much THC does Mellowz have?

Compound Genetics reports Mellowz flower consistently testing around 27–30% THC or higher. Actual cannabinoid concentration still depends on phenotype, cultivation environment, harvest maturity, curing, and laboratory methodology.
How long does Mellowz take to flower?

Indoor flowering generally takes approximately 8–9 weeks, or roughly 56–63 days. Outdoor harvest typically falls from late September through October in suitable Northern Hemisphere climates, depending on local flowering onset and weather.
Final Thoughts on Mellowz

Mellowz earned its reputation by succeeding in areas that do not always coexist in the same cannabis plant. It delivers the near-black coloration and extreme frost expected from exotic flower while preserving vigorous growth and useful production potential. More importantly, those visual characteristics are backed by a distinctive terpene profile rather than serving as decoration around otherwise forgettable weed.

The pedigree explains much of that balance. Cannarado’s Spritzer contributes production, delicate flavor, and aromatic translation, while Compound’s Grape Gas supplies dark fruit, candy, resin, and the genetic backbone of one of the breeder’s most successful families. The combination produced an unusually deep pool of keepers and eventually became important enough to inspire further breeding work centered on Mellowz itself.

For consumers, ripe plum, berries, sweet fruit, and candy provide a richer alternative to simple grape gas, while THC levels commonly reaching 27–30% or more give the flower substantial strength. For growers, fast vegetative growth, an 8–9-week bloom, dark compact buds, and dense trichomes create a weed strain with value in both flower and solventless production. Mellowz ultimately stands as one of Compound Genetics’ clearest examples of modern exotic cannabis where appearance, flavor, potency, and garden performance all contribute equally to the strain’s identity.
